title: Design System: Shithead — The Card Table

wordmark.purpose: Serif identity in the compact HUD.

shadows.name: hand-card
shadows.purpose: Hand cards against the lower table vignette.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied globally when reduced motion is requested.

cardInteraction.selection: Click matching cards or use numbered quantity buttons; subsets preserve selected suits.
cardInteraction.drag: Mouse, pen and touch pointer events; selected stack follows pointer; legal pile highlight; outside release cancels.
cardInteraction.touch: Horizontal hand scrolling and upward card dragging.
cardInteraction.aceChoice: Inline 1 or high (14) actions when ace is on ace; seven forces ace to 1.
cardInteraction.overflow: All hand rows use safe center alignment.

physicalCards.identity: One cached button per physical card ID; unchanged SVG artwork is retained.
physicalCards.travel: 340ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), position and scale only on real moves
physicalCards.openingDeal: 18 sequential 180ms card flights, alternating players by down/up/hand layer
physicalCards.setup: Bidirectional drag-to-swap hand and face-up cards
physicalCards.endgame: Active up/down zone moves into the large main tray; 18dvh card height
physicalCards.table: CC0 Poly Haven Caban wool, blue tint, dark rail; original blue/gold geometric card backs
physicalCards.compact: 319×524 supported: compact 40px action row, 13dvh hand cards, 15dvh endgame cards, turn guidance above reserve

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Commit a selected card or start another deal.

components.name: Pick up action
components.description: Secondary action shown when the human can collect the pile.

components.name: HUD navigation
components.description: Compact utilities with clearly labeled sound state and rules access.

components.name: Thinking chip
components.description: Opponent turn indicator, paired with written status.

components.name: Paper dialog surface
components.description: Rules and credits appear on warm paper above the dark game.
components.html:
A fresh deal?

Your current game will be replaced. Your running score stays.

components.name: Action status
components.description: Written action guidance is paired with a compact colored state dot.
components.html:
Your turn. Match or beat 8.

Select matching cards, then play. Or pick up the pile.

narrative.overview: Operate mode. A code-led, full-viewport game in a quiet social card club. Evergreen fabric, recognizable French playing cards, warm gold and classical serif identity surround a dense operational interface. The final game-layout.css layer governs the composition; paper is the modal context.
keyCharacteristics: Immediate deal and clear committed action

rules.name: Viewport ownership
rules.body: The game owns 100dvh; the shell is full-bleed and square.

rules.name: Visible state
rules.body: Selection, keyboard focus and turn ownership retain distinct written and visual signals.

dos: Do preserve local card, fabric and font assets and their credits.
Do keep crowded hands scrollable and respect safe-area padding.
donts: Do not restore the hidden landing-page hero as the gameplay composition.
Do not apply the old rounded shell to the full-viewport table.
Do not expose hidden opponent cards.
